cves.headline: LlamaIndex 0.12.33 lets local users tamper with shared NLTK data files

name: Insecure Temporary File
title: CWE-377: Insecure Temporary File
ai_text: In AI software this weakness shows up in LLM application frameworks, as the single CVE here, CVE-2025-7707, is in LlamaIndex. The issue is that LlamaIndex 0.12.33 lets local users tamper with shared NLTK data files, which are temporary or cached files used by the framework. The usual way it is reached is through local access to the machine running the application, where those shared files sit in a location other users can write to. Once tampered with, the files can feed altered data into the framework, letting an attacker affect how the application behaves. Only LlamaIndex appears as an example in this class.
description: Creating and using insecure temporary files can leave application and system data vulnerable to attack.
